akhfash:5-5.t: He said ﴿رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَٱلأَرْضِ﴾ on the basis of "that your god is the Lord…". Some put ﴿رَبَّ السَّماَواَتِ﴾ ﴿وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَشَارِقِ﴾ in the accusative, making it an attribute of the noun on which "إِنَّ" falls. The first is better, because the first is in this meaning, while (the other) is a far-fetched interpretation.

akhfash:6-6.t: And He said ﴿زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِزِينَةٍ ٱلْكَوَاكِبِ﴾: He made ﴿الكواكب﴾ (the stars) a badal (substitute) for "the adornment". Some read ﴿بِزينةِ الكواكبِ﴾ (with the adornment of the stars), and he does not mean some of them; rather, their adornment is their beauty.

akhfash:7-7.t: And He said ﴿وَحِفْظاً﴾ because it is a substitute for the utterance of the verb, as though He said: "and We guarded it with a guarding".

akhfash:52-52.t: And He said ﴿لَمِنَ ٱلْمُصَدِّقِينَ﴾. Some doubled it (i.e. read المُصَّدِّقين), but the doubling has no (proper) meaning (here); the meaning of the doubling is "المُتَصَدِّقِين" (those who give alms), and this is not that meaning. The meaning of this is from "التَّصْديق" (believing as true), [and] not from "التَصَدُّقِ" (giving alms); [and] only the latter is doubled, and everything else is light. "والصَّدَقَةُ" (alms) has its ṣād doubled (in the derived verb), and that is different from this. A man was asked about his companion, and he related about his comrade in the world, saying: ﴿كَانَ لِي قَرِينٌ﴾ who would say: ﴿أَإِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُصَدِّقِينَ﴾ that we will be resurrected after death? i.e. do you believe this? i.e. do you affirm this as true?

akhfash:103-103.t: And He said ﴿وَتَلَّهُ لِلْجَبِينِ﴾, just as you say: "أكبَّهُ لوجهه" and "أَكْبَبْتُهُ لِوَجْهِه" (I threw him on his face), because in meaning it resembles "أَقْصَيْتهُ" (I put him far away).

akhfash:147-147.t: And He said ﴿مِئَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ﴾: He means "they were thus in your estimation".

celaleyn:102-102.t: ﴿فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ السَّعْيَ﴾ i.e. [reached the age] that he could run about with him and help him. It is said he had reached seven years, and it is said thirteen years. ﴿قَالَ يَا بُنَيَّ إِنِّي أَرَى﴾ i.e. I saw ﴿فِي الْمَنَامِ أَنِّي أَذْبَحُكَ﴾ and the dreams of the prophets are true, and their actions are by the command of Allah the Exalted. ﴿فَانْظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَى﴾ by way of opinion; he consulted him so that he would become reconciled to the slaughter and submit to the command concerning it. ﴿قَالَ يَا أَبَتِ﴾ the tāʾ is a substitute for the yāʾ of the possessive (iḍāfa). ﴿افْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ﴾ to do ﴿سَتَجِدُنِي إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ مِنَ الصَّابِرِينَ﴾ in that.

celaleyn:103-103.t: ﴿فَلَمَّا أَسْلَمَا﴾ they both yielded and submitted to the command of Allah the Exalted ﴿وَتَلَّهُ لِلْجَبِينِ﴾ he laid him down on it. Every person has two jabīns (sides of the forehead), with the forehead (jabha) between them. That took place at Minā. He passed the knife over his throat, but it did nothing, because of a hindrance from the divine power.

celaleyn:104-104.t: ﴿وَنَادَيْنَاهُ أَنْ يَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ﴾ [Translator's note: al-Jalalayn gives no explanation here.]

celaleyn:105-105.t: ﴿قَدْ صَدَّقْتَ الرُّؤْيَا﴾ by what you did of the matter of the slaughter as far as was possible for you, i.e. that suffices you. So the clause "نَادَيْنَاهُ" is the jawāb (answer) of "لَمَّا", with the wāw being redundant (zāʾida). ﴿إِنَّا كَذَلِكَ﴾ just as We have rewarded you ﴿نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ﴾ to themselves by obeying the command, [rewarding them] by relieving them of hardship.

celaleyn:106-106.t: ﴿إِنَّ هَذَا﴾ the slaughter that was commanded ﴿لَهُوَ الْبَلَاءُ الْمُبِينُ﴾ the manifest test.

celaleyn:107-107.t: ﴿وَفَدَيْنَاهُ﴾ i.e. the one whose slaughter had been commanded, who is Ismāʿīl or Isḥāq: two views ﴿بِذِبْحٍ﴾ with a ram ﴿عَظِيمٍ﴾ from Paradise; it is the one that Hābīl (Abel) had offered. Jibrīl, peace be upon him, brought it, and the master Ibrāhīm slaughtered it saying "Allāhu akbar".

celaleyn:108-108.t: ﴿وَتَرَكْنَا﴾ We preserved ﴿عَلَيْهِ فِي الْآخِرِينَ﴾ a beautiful praise.

celaleyn:110-110.t: ﴿كَذَلِكَ﴾ just as We rewarded him ﴿نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ﴾ to themselves.

celaleyn:111-111.t: ﴿إِنَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ [Translator's note: al-Jalalayn gives no explanation here.]

celaleyn:112-112.t: ﴿وَبَشَّرْنَاهُ بِإِسْحَاقَ﴾ this has been taken as evidence that the one to be slaughtered was someone other than him. ﴿نَبِيًّا﴾ an anticipated ḥāl (circumstantial; ḥāl muqaddara), i.e. he would come into existence with his prophethood decreed ﴿مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ﴾

celaleyn:113-113.t: ﴿وَبَارَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ﴾ by multiplying his offspring ﴿وَعَلَى إِسْحَاقَ﴾ his son, by Our making most of the prophets from his descendants ﴿وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحْسِنٌ﴾ a believer ﴿وَظَالِمٌ لِنَفْسِهِ﴾ a disbeliever ﴿مُبِينٌ﴾ manifest in disbelief.

celaleyn:114-114.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَى مُوسَى وَهَارُونَ﴾ with prophethood.

celaleyn:115-115.t: ﴿وَنَجَّيْنَاهُمَا وَقَوْمَهُمَا﴾ the Children of Israel ﴿مِنَ الْكَرْبِ الْعَظِيمِ﴾ i.e. Pharaoh's enslavement of them.

celaleyn:117-117.t: ﴿وَآتَيْنَاهُمَا الْكِتَابَ الْمُسْتَبِينَ﴾ the one most eloquent in clarity in what it brought of the legal limits, rulings and other things; it is the Torah.

celaleyn:119-119.t: ﴿وَتَرَكْنَا﴾ We preserved ﴿عَلَيْهِمَا فِي الْآخِرِينَ﴾ a beautiful praise.

celaleyn:121-121.t: ﴿إِنَّا كَذَلِكَ﴾ just as We rewarded the two of them ﴿نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ﴾

celaleyn:122-122.t: ﴿إِنَّهُمَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ [Translator's note: al-Jalalayn gives no explanation here.]

celaleyn:123-123.t: ﴿وَإِنَّ إِلْيَاسَ﴾ with the hamza at its beginning, and without it ﴿لَمِنَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ﴾ it is said that he was the son of the brother of Hārūn, the brother of Mūsā; and it is said someone else. He was sent to a people in Baalbek and its surroundings.

celaleyn:124-124.t: ﴿إِذْ﴾ accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muqaddar) "اذْكُرْ" ("remember") ﴿قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ﴾ Allah?

celaleyn:125-125.t: ﴿أَتَدْعُونَ بَعْلًا﴾ the name of an idol of theirs made of gold, after which the town too was named, in iḍāfa (genitive construct) with "بَكّ" [i.e. Baʿlabakk]; i.e. do you worship it ﴿وَتَذَرُونَ﴾ and leave ﴿أَحْسَنَ الْخَالِقِينَ﴾ so that you do not worship Him?

celaleyn:126-126.t: ﴿اللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ آبَائِكُمُ الْأَوَّلِينَ﴾ with the three in the nominative, on the basis of an implied "هُوَ" ("He"), and with them in the accusative as a badal (substitute) for "أَحْسَنَ" [اللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ وَرَبَّ].

celaleyn:128-128.t: ﴿إِلَّا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ الْمُخْلَصِينَ﴾ i.e. the believers among them, for they were saved from it.

celaleyn:129-129.t: ﴿وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِي الْآخِرِينَ﴾ a beautiful praise.

celaleyn:130-130.t: ﴿سَلَامٌ﴾ from Us ﴿عَلَى إِلْ يَاسِينَ﴾ he is Ilyās, mentioned above. It is also said: he and those who believed with him, so they were pluralised together with him by taghlīb (letting one name prevail over the group), like their saying "al-Muhallabūn" for al-Muhallab and his people. On the reading "آلِ يَاسِينَ" with the long vowel, i.e. his family, what is meant by it is also Ilyās.

celaleyn:131-131.t: ﴿إِنَّا كَذَلِكَ﴾ just as We rewarded him ﴿نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ﴾

celaleyn:132-132.t: ﴿إِنَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ [Translator's note: al-Jalalayn gives no explanation here.]

celaleyn:134-134.t: ﴿إِذْ نَجَّيْنَاهُ وَأَهْلَهُ أَجْمَعِينَ﴾ [Translator's note: al-Jalalayn gives no explanation here; the implied "اذْكُرْ" ("Remember") at the end of the previous entry governs this "إِذْ".]

celaleyn:135-135.t: ﴿إِلَّا عَجُوزًا فِي الْغَابِرِينَ﴾ i.e. those remaining in the punishment.

celaleyn:136-136.t: ﴿ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا﴾ We destroyed ﴿الْآخَرِينَ﴾ the disbelievers among his people.

celaleyn:137-137.t: ﴿وَإِنَّكُمْ لَتَمُرُّونَ عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ over their remains and dwellings on your journeys ﴿مُصْبِحِينَ﴾ i.e. at the time of morning, meaning by day

celaleyn:138-138.t: ﴿وَبِاللَّيْلِ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ﴾ O people of Mecca, what befell them, so that you take a lesson from it?

celaleyn:139-139.t: ﴿وَإِنَّ يُونُسَ لَمِنَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ﴾ [Translator's note: al-Jalalayn gives no explanation here.]

celaleyn:140-140.t: ﴿إِذْ أَبَقَ﴾ fled ﴿إِلَى الْفُلْكِ الْمَشْحُونِ﴾ the laden ship, when he left his people in anger, since the punishment he had promised them did not descend upon them. He boarded the ship, and it stood still in the depths of the sea. The sailors said: "Here is a slave who has run away from his master; the lot will reveal him."

celaleyn:141-141.t: ﴿فَسَاهَمَ﴾ he cast lots with the people of the ship ﴿فَكَانَ مِنَ الْمُدْحَضِينَ﴾ the losers, so they threw him into the sea.

celaleyn:142-142.t: ﴿فَالْتَقَمَهُ الْحُوتُ﴾ swallowed him ﴿وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ﴾ i.e. having done what he is blamed for: his going to the sea and boarding the ship without permission from his Lord.

celaleyn:143-143.t: ﴿فَلَوْلَا أَنَّهُ كَانَ مِنَ الْمُسَبِّحِينَ﴾ those who remember [Allah], by his saying often in the belly of the fish: {لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ}

celaleyn:144-144.t: ﴿لَلَبِثَ فِي بَطْنِهِ إِلَى يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ﴾ the belly of the fish would have become a grave for him until the Day of Resurrection.

celaleyn:145-145.t: ﴿فَنَبَذْنَاهُ﴾ We cast him out of the belly of the fish ﴿بِالْعَرَاءِ﴾ onto the face of the earth, i.e. onto the shore, the same day, or after three or seven days, or twenty or forty days ﴿وَهُوَ سَقِيمٌ﴾ ill, like a featherless chick.

celaleyn:146-146.t: ﴿وَأَنْبَتْنَا عَلَيْهِ شَجَرَةً مِنْ يَقْطِينٍ﴾ which is the gourd, shading him on a stem, contrary to what is usual for gourds, as a miracle for him. A mountain goat (waʿila) used to come to him morning and evening, and he drank from its milk until he grew strong.

celaleyn:147-147.t: ﴿وَأَرْسَلْنَاهُ﴾ after that, as before it, to a people at Nineveh in the land of Mosul ﴿إِلَى مِائَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ﴾ rather ﴿يَزِيدُونَ﴾ by twenty, or thirty, or seventy thousand.

celaleyn:148-148.t: ﴿فَآمَنُوا﴾ upon seeing the punishment they had been promised ﴿فَمَتَّعْنَاهُمْ﴾ We kept them enjoying what they had ﴿إِلَى حِينٍ﴾ in which their terms come to an end.

celaleyn:149-149.t: ﴿فَاسْتَفْتِهِمْ﴾ ask the disbelievers of Mecca, by way of rebuke to them: ﴿أَلِرَبِّكَ الْبَنَاتُ﴾ according to their claim that the angels are the daughters of Allah ﴿وَلَهُمُ الْبَنُونَ﴾ so that they keep the more excellent for themselves?

celaleyn:150-150.t: ﴿أَمْ خَلَقْنَا الْمَلَائِكَةَ إِنَاثًا وَهُمْ شَاهِدُونَ﴾ Our creating [them], so that they say that?

celaleyn:152-152.t: ﴿وَلَدَ اللَّهُ﴾ by their saying, "The angels are the daughters of Allah" ﴿وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَاذِبُونَ﴾ in it.

celaleyn:153-153.t: ﴿أَصْطَفَى﴾ with the hamza vowelled with fatḥa, for the interrogative; it dispenses with the connecting hamza (hamzat al-waṣl), which is therefore dropped; i.e. has He chosen ﴿الْبَنَاتِ عَلَى الْبَنِينَ﴾?

celaleyn:154-154.t: ﴿مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ﴾ this corrupt judgement?

celaleyn:155-155.t: ﴿أَفَلَا تَذَّكَّرُونَ﴾ with assimilation (idghām) of the tāʾ into the dhāl, that He, Glorified and Exalted is He, is far above having a child [تَذَكَّرُونَ]?

celaleyn:156-156.t: ﴿أَمْ لَكُمْ سُلْطَانٌ مُبِينٌ﴾ a clear proof that Allah has a child?

celaleyn:157-157.t: ﴿فَأْتُوا بِكِتَابِكُمْ﴾ the Torah, and show me that in it ﴿إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ﴾ in that saying of yours.

celaleyn:158-158.t: ﴿وَجَعَلُوا﴾ i.e. the idolaters ﴿بَيْنَهُ﴾ the Exalted ﴿وَبَيْنَ الْجِنَّةِ﴾ i.e. the angels, because of their being concealed (ijtinān) from sight ﴿نَسَبًا﴾ by their saying that they are the daughters of Allah. ﴿وَلَقَدْ عَلِمَتِ الْجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمْ﴾ i.e. those who say that ﴿لَمُحْضَرُونَ﴾ to the Fire, being punished in it.

celaleyn:159-159.t: ﴿سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ﴾ declaring Him transcendent ﴿عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ﴾ in that Allah has a child,

celaleyn:160-160.t: ﴿إِلَّا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ الْمُخْلَصِينَ﴾ i.e. the believers; a disconnected exception (istithnāʾ munqaṭiʿ), i.e. for they declare Allah the Exalted transcendent above what these describe Him with.

celaleyn:162-162.t: ﴿مَا أَنْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ﴾ i.e. against what you worship; "عَلَيْهِ" is attached to (mutaʿalliq) His saying ﴿بِفَاتِنِينَ﴾ i.e. anyone,

celaleyn:163-163.t: ﴿إِلَّا مَنْ هُوَ صَالِ الْجَحِيمِ﴾ in the knowledge of Allah the Exalted. Jibrīl said to the Prophet ﷺ:

celaleyn:164-164.t: ﴿وَمَا مِنَّا﴾ we the company of angels, anyone ﴿إِلَّا لَهُ مَقَامٌ مَعْلُومٌ﴾ in the heavens, in which he worships Allah and which he does not go beyond.

celaleyn:165-165.t: ﴿وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ الصَّافُّونَ﴾ our feet in prayer,

celaleyn:166-166.t: ﴿وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ الْمُسَبِّحُونَ﴾ those who declare Allah transcendent above what does not befit Him.

celaleyn:167-167.t: ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ lightened from the heavy [إِنَّ] ﴿كَانُوا﴾ i.e. the disbelievers of Mecca ﴿لَيَقُولُونَ﴾

celaleyn:168-168.t: ﴿لَوْ أَنَّ عِنْدَنَا ذِكْرًا﴾ a book ﴿مِنَ الْأَوَّلِينَ﴾ i.e. from the books of the past nations,

celaleyn:169-169.t: ﴿لَكُنَّا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ الْمُخْلَصِينَ﴾ in worship to Him. The Exalted said:

celaleyn:170-170.t: ﴿فَكَفَرُوا بِهِ﴾ i.e. in the Book that came to them, which is the Quran, nobler than those books ﴿فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ the outcome of their disbelief.

celaleyn:171-171.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ سَبَقَتْ كَلِمَتُنَا﴾ of victory ﴿لِعِبَادِنَا الْمُرْسَلِينَ﴾ and it is {لَأَغْلِبَنَّ أَنَا وَرُسُلِي}, or it is His saying:

celaleyn:172-172.t: ﴿إِنَّهُمْ لَهُمُ الْمَنْصُورُونَ﴾ [Translator's note: al-Jalalayn gives no explanation here.]

celaleyn:173-173.t: ﴿وَإِنَّ جُنْدَنَا﴾ the believers ﴿لَهُمُ الْغَالِبُونَ﴾ over the disbelievers, by argument and by victory over them in this world; and if some of them are not victorious in this world, then in the Hereafter.

celaleyn:174-174.t: ﴿فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ﴾ i.e. turn away from the disbelievers of Mecca ﴿حَتَّى حِينٍ﴾ in which you will be commanded to fight them.

celaleyn:175-175.t: ﴿وَأَبْصِرْهُمْ﴾ when the punishment descends upon them ﴿فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ﴾ the outcome of their disbelief. So they said mockingly, "When will this punishment come down?" The Exalted said, threatening them:

celaleyn:176-176.t: ﴿أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ﴾ [Translator's note: al-Jalalayn gives no explanation here.]

celaleyn:177-177.t: ﴿فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ﴾ in their courtyard. Al-Farrāʾ said: the Arabs make do with mentioning the courtyard (sāḥa) instead of the people. ﴿فَسَاءَ﴾ evil is it as a morning ﴿صَبَاحُ الْمُنْذَرِينَ﴾ In it there is the putting of the overt noun in place of the pronoun.

celaleyn:178-178.t: ﴿وَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّى حِينٍ﴾ [Translator's note: al-Jalalayn gives no explanation here.]

celaleyn:179-179.t: ﴿وَأَبْصِرْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ﴾ He repeated it as emphasis of the threat to them and as a consolation for him ﷺ.

celaleyn:180-180.t: ﴿سُبْحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ الْعِزَّةِ﴾ the dominance ﴿عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ﴾ in that He has a child.

celaleyn:181-181.t: ﴿وَسَلَامٌ عَلَى الْمُرْسَلِينَ﴾ who conveyed from Allah the affirmation of His oneness (tawḥīd) and the laws.

celaleyn:182-182.t: ﴿وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ﴾ for their victory and the destruction of the disbelievers.

celaleyn:1-1.t: ﴿وَالصَّافَّاتِ صَفًّا﴾ the angels, who range themselves in rows in worship, or [range] their wings in the air, awaiting what they are commanded

celaleyn:2-2.t: ﴿فَالزَّاجِرَاتِ زَجْرًا﴾ the angels who drive the clouds, i.e. herd them along

celaleyn:3-3.t: ﴿فَالتَّالِيَاتِ﴾ i.e. the reciters of the Qur'an, who recite it ﴿ذِكْرًا﴾ a maṣdar (verbal noun) from the meaning of «التَّالِيَاتِ»

celaleyn:5-5.t: ﴿رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ الْمَشَارِقِ﴾ i.e. and the places of setting, of the sun; it has a place of rising and a place of setting every day

celaleyn:6-6.t: ﴿إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا السَّمَاءَ الدُّنْيَا بِزِينَةِ الْكَوَاكِبِ﴾ i.e. with their light, or with them [themselves], and the iḍāfa (genitive construct) is explicative (li-l-bayān), like the reading with nunation on [زِينَةٍ], which is explained by «الْكَوَاكِبِ»

celaleyn:7-7.t: ﴿وَحِفْظًا﴾ accusative by an implied (muqaddar) verb, i.e. "and We guarded it with shooting stars" ﴿مِنْ كُلِّ﴾ attached (mutaʿalliq) to the implied [verb] ﴿شَيْطَانٍ مَارِدٍ﴾ insolent, departing from obedience

celaleyn:8-8.t: ﴿لَا يَسْمَعُونَ﴾ i.e. the devils; resumptive (mustaʾnaf), and their listening is, in meaning, what [the heaven] is guarded against ﴿إِلَى الْمَلَإِ الْأَعْلَى﴾ the angels in heaven; and listening is made transitive with «إِلَى» because it includes the meaning of giving ear; and in one reading [يَسَّمَّعُونَ], with doubling of the mīm and the sīn, its original form being «يَتَسَمَّعُونَ», the tāʾ being assimilated into the sīn ﴿وَيُقْذَفُونَ﴾ the devils, with shooting stars ﴿مِنْ كُلِّ جَانِبٍ﴾ from the horizons of heaven

celaleyn:9-9.t: ﴿دُحُورًا﴾ the maṣdar (verbal noun) of «دَحَرَهُ», i.e. he drove him away and removed him far, and it is a mafʿūl lahu (object of purpose) ﴿وَلَهُمْ﴾ in the Hereafter ﴿عَذَابٌ وَاصِبٌ﴾ perpetual

celaleyn:10-10.t: ﴿إِلَّا مَنْ خَطِفَ الْخَطْفَةَ﴾ a maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. the single time; and the exception is from the pronoun of «يَسْمَعُونَ», i.e. none hears except the devil who heard the word from the angels and took it quickly ﴿فَأَتْبَعَهُ شِهَابٌ﴾ a shining star ﴿ثَاقِبٌ﴾ which pierces him, or burns him, or deranges him

celaleyn:11-11.t: ﴿فَاسْتَفْتِهِمْ﴾ ask the disbelievers of Mecca, by way of affirmation or rebuke ﴿أَهُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمْ مَنْ خَلَقْنَا﴾ of angels, the heavens, the earths and what is in them; and in using «مَنْ» there is giving precedence (taghlīb) to those endowed with reason ﴿إِنَّا خَلَقْنَاهُمْ﴾ i.e. their origin, Adam ﴿مِنْ طِينٍ لَازِبٍ﴾ sticky, clinging to the hand. The meaning is that their creation is weak, so let them not be arrogant by denying the Prophet and the Qur'an, which leads to their destruction, [which is] easy

celaleyn:12-12.t: ﴿بَلْ﴾ for transition from one purpose to another, which is reporting his state and their state ﴿عَجِبْتَ﴾ with fatḥa on the tāʾ, addressing the Prophet ﷺ, i.e. at their belying you ﴿وَ﴾ they ﴿يَسْخَرُونَ﴾ at your wonder

celaleyn:13-13.t: ﴿وَإِذَا ذُكِّرُوا﴾ are admonished with the Qur'an ﴿لَا يَذْكُرُونَ﴾ they do not take admonition

celaleyn:14-14.t: ﴿وَإِذَا رَأَوْا آيَةً﴾ such as the splitting of the moon ﴿يَسْتَسْخِرُونَ﴾ they mock it

celaleyn:15-15.t: ﴿وَقَالُوا﴾ about it ﴿إِنْ﴾ [meaning] «مَا» (not) ﴿هَذَا إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُبِينٌ﴾ clear; and they said, denying the resurrection:

celaleyn:16-16.t: ﴿أَإِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَامًا أَإِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ﴾ in the two hamzas in both places there is full pronunciation (taḥqīq), easing (tashīl) of the second, and the insertion of an alif between them in both ways

celaleyn:17-17.t: ﴿أَوْ آبَاؤُنَا الْأَوَّلُونَ﴾ with the wāw vowelless, conjoining with «أَوْ», and with fatḥa on it, the hamza being for interrogation [أَوَ] and the conjunction being with the wāw; and what is conjoined to is the position of «إِنَّ» and its noun, or the pronoun in «لَمَبْعُوثُونَ», the separator being the interrogative hamza

celaleyn:18-18.t: ﴿قُلْ نَعَمْ﴾ you will be resurrected ﴿وَأَنْتُمْ دَاخِرُونَ﴾ abased

celaleyn:19-19.t: ﴿فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ﴾ a vague pronoun, explained by ﴿زَجْرَةٌ﴾ i.e. a shout ﴿وَاحِدَةٌ فَإِذَا هُمْ﴾ the creatures, alive ﴿يَنْظُرُونَ﴾ at what is done with them

celaleyn:20-20.t: ﴿وَقَالُوا﴾ i.e. the disbelievers ﴿يَا﴾ for drawing attention (tanbīh) ﴿وَيْلَنَا﴾ our destruction; and it is a maṣdar (verbal noun) that has no verb from its root; and the angels say to them: ﴿هَذَا يَوْمُ الدِّينِ﴾ i.e. the day of reckoning and recompense

celaleyn:21-21.t: ﴿هَذَا يَوْمُ الْفَصْلِ﴾ between the creatures ﴿الَّذِي كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ﴾ and it is said to the angels:

celaleyn:22-22.t: ﴿احْشُرُوا الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا﴾ themselves, by idolatry ﴿وَأَزْوَاجَهُمْ﴾ their companions among the devils ﴿وَمَا كَانُوا يَعْبُدُونَ﴾

celaleyn:23-23.t: ﴿مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ﴾ i.e. other than Him, of the idols ﴿فَاهْدُوهُمْ﴾ direct them and drive them ﴿إِلَى صِرَاطِ الْجَحِيمِ﴾ the way of the Fire

celaleyn:24-24.t: ﴿وَقِفُوهُمْ﴾ detain them at the Bridge (al-Ṣirāṭ) ﴿إِنَّهُمْ مَسْئُولُونَ﴾ about all their words and deeds; and it is said to them, by way of rebuke:

celaleyn:25-25.t: ﴿مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنَاصَرُونَ﴾ you do not help one another, as was your state in this world; and it is said of them:

celaleyn:27-27.t: ﴿وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ﴾ blaming one another and disputing

celaleyn:28-28.t: ﴿قَالُوا﴾ i.e. the followers among them, to those followed ﴿إِنَّكُمْ كُنْتُمْ تَأْتُونَنَا عَنِ الْيَمِينِ﴾ from the direction from which we felt secure from you, because you swore that you were on the truth, so we believed you and followed you. The meaning is: you led us astray

celaleyn:29-29.t: ﴿قَالُوا﴾ i.e. those followed, to them ﴿بَلْ لَمْ تَكُونُوا مُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ and leading astray would truly be from us only if you had been believers and then turned back from faith to us

celaleyn:30-30.t: ﴿وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيْكُمْ مِنْ سُلْطَانٍ﴾ strength and power by which we could compel you to follow us ﴿بَلْ كُنْتُمْ قَوْمًا طَاغِينَ﴾ astray like us

celaleyn:31-31.t: ﴿فَحَقَّ﴾ has become binding ﴿عَلَيْنَا﴾ all ﴿قَوْلُ رَبِّنَا﴾ of punishment, i.e. His saying {لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ} ﴿إِنَّا﴾ all ﴿لَذَائِقُونَ﴾ the punishment, by that saying; and from it arose their saying:

celaleyn:32-32.t: ﴿فَأَغْوَيْنَاكُمْ﴾ which is given its reason by His words ﴿إِنَّا كُنَّا غَاوِينَ﴾ The Exalted said:

celaleyn:33-33.t: ﴿فَإِنَّهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ﴾ on the Day of Resurrection ﴿فِي الْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ﴾ i.e. because of their sharing in error

celaleyn:34-34.t: ﴿إِنَّا كَذَلِكَ﴾ as We do with these ﴿نَفْعَلُ بِالْمُجْرِمِينَ﴾ other than these, i.e. We punish them, the follower among them and the followed

celaleyn:35-35.t: ﴿إِنَّهُمْ﴾ i.e. these, as indicated by what follows ﴿كَانُوا إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ﴾

celaleyn:36-36.t: ﴿وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا﴾ in its two hamzas there is what has preceded ﴿لَتَارِكُو آلِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٍ مَجْنُونٍ﴾ i.e. for the sake of Muhammad. The Exalted said:

celaleyn:37-37.t: ﴿بَلْ جَاءَ بِالْحَقِّ وَصَدَّقَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ﴾ who came with it, and it is that there is no god but Allah

celaleyn:38-38.t: ﴿إِنَّكُمْ﴾ in it there is a shift (iltifāt) ﴿لَذَائِقُو الْعَذَابِ الْأَلِيمِ﴾

celaleyn:39-39.t: ﴿وَمَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا﴾ the recompense of ﴿مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ﴾

celaleyn:40-40.t: ﴿إِلَّا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ الْمُخْلَصِينَ﴾ the believers; a disconnected exception (istithnāʾ munqaṭiʿ); their recompense is mentioned in His words:

celaleyn:41-41.t: ﴿أُولَئِكَ لَهُمْ﴾ in Paradise ﴿رِزْقٌ مَعْلُومٌ﴾ morning and evening

celaleyn:42-42.t: ﴿فَوَاكِهُ﴾ a badal (substitute) or bayān (explication) of «الرِّزْقِ», and it is what is eaten for pleasure, not to preserve health, because the people of Paradise have no need of preserving it, their bodies being created for eternity ﴿وَهُمْ مُكْرَمُونَ﴾ with the reward of Allah, Glorified and Exalted is He

celaleyn:43-43.t: ﴿فِي جَنَّاتِ النَّعِيمِ﴾ [Translator's note: al-Jalalayn gives no explanation here]

celaleyn:44-44.t: ﴿عَلَى سُرُرٍ مُتَقَابِلِينَ﴾ none of them sees the back of another's head

celaleyn:45-45.t: ﴿يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ upon each of them ﴿بِكَأْسٍ﴾ it is the vessel with its drink ﴿مِنْ مَعِينٍ﴾ of wine flowing on the surface of the ground like rivers of water

celaleyn:46-46.t: ﴿بَيْضَاءَ﴾ whiter than milk ﴿لَذَّةٍ﴾ delicious ﴿لِلشَّارِبِينَ﴾ unlike the wine of this world, for it is disagreeable when drunk

celaleyn:47-47.t: ﴿لَا فِيهَا غَوْلٌ﴾ anything that takes away their minds ﴿وَلَا هُمْ عَنْهَا يُنْزَفُونَ﴾ with fatḥa and with kasra on the zāy, from «نَزَفَ الشَّارِبُ» and «أَنْزَفَ», i.e. they become intoxicated; unlike the wine of this world

celaleyn:48-48.t: ﴿وَعِنْدَهُمْ قَاصِرَاتُ الطَّرْفِ﴾ restraining their eyes to their husbands, not looking at others because of how handsome they are to them ﴿عِينٌ﴾ wide-eyed, beautiful-eyed

celaleyn:49-49.t: ﴿كَأَنَّهُنَّ﴾ in colour ﴿بَيْضٌ﴾ of the ostrich ﴿مَكْنُونٌ﴾ covered with its feathers, no dust reaching it; and its colour, which is white tinged with yellow, is the most beautiful of women's colours

celaleyn:50-50.t: ﴿فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ﴾ some of the people of Paradise ﴿عَلَى بَعْضٍ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ﴾ about what they went through in this world

celaleyn:51-51.t: ﴿قَالَ قَائِلٌ مِنْهُمْ إِنِّي كَانَ لِي قَرِينٌ﴾ a companion who denied the resurrection.

celaleyn:52-52.t: ﴿يَقُولُ﴾ to me, reproachfully ﴿أَإِنَّكَ لَمِنَ الْمُصَدِّقِينَ﴾ of the resurrection

celaleyn:53-53.t: ﴿أَإِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَامًا أَإِنَّا﴾ in the two hamzas in the three places there is what has preceded ﴿لَمَدِينُونَ﴾ recompensed and called to account? He denied that as well

celaleyn:54-54.t: ﴿قَالَ﴾ that speaker, to his brethren ﴿هَلْ أَنْتُمْ مُطَّلِعُونَ﴾ with me, upon the Fire, so that we may see his state? And they say, "No"

celaleyn:55-55.t: ﴿فَاطَّلَعَ﴾ that speaker, from one of the windows of Paradise ﴿فَرَآهُ﴾ i.e. he saw his companion ﴿فِي سَوَاءِ الْجَحِيمِ﴾ i.e. the middle of the Fire

celaleyn:56-56.t: ﴿قَالَ﴾ to him, gloating ﴿تَاللَّهِ إِنْ﴾ «إِنْ» lightened from the heavy [«إِنَّ»] ﴿كِدْتَ﴾ you came near ﴿لَتُرْدِينِ﴾ to destroying me by your leading astray

celaleyn:57-57.t: ﴿وَلَوْلَا نِعْمَةُ رَبِّي﴾ upon me, by faith ﴿لَكُنْتُ مِنَ الْمُحْضَرِينَ﴾ with you in the Fire; and the people of Paradise say:

celaleyn:58-58.t: ﴿أَفَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَيِّتِينَ﴾ [Translator's note: al-Jalalayn gives no explanation here; the explanation follows in the next ayah]

celaleyn:59-59.t: ﴿إِلَّا مَوْتَتَنَا الْأُولَى﴾ which was in this world ﴿وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ﴾ it is an interrogative of delight and of speaking of Allah the Exalted's blessing in making life everlasting and in not punishing

celaleyn:60-60.t: ﴿إِنَّ هَذَا﴾ which has been mentioned for the people of Paradise ﴿لَهُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ﴾

celaleyn:61-61.t: ﴿لِمِثْلِ هَذَا فَلْيَعْمَلِ الْعَامِلُونَ﴾ it is said that this is said to them, and it is said that they say it

celaleyn:62-62.t: ﴿أَذَلِكَ﴾ which has been mentioned for them ﴿خَيْرٌ نُزُلًا﴾ and it is what is prepared for one who arrives, a guest or another ﴿أَمْ شَجَرَةُ الزَّقُّومِ﴾ prepared for the people of the Fire; and it is among the foulest of bitter trees in Tihāma; Allah makes it grow in Hell, as will come

celaleyn:63-63.t: ﴿إِنَّا جَعَلْنَاهَا﴾ by that ﴿فِتْنَةً لِلظَّالِمِينَ﴾ i.e. the disbelievers among the people of Mecca, since they said, "Fire burns trees, so how can it make them grow?"

celaleyn:64-64.t: ﴿إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٌ تَخْرُجُ فِي أَصْلِ الْجَحِيمِ﴾ i.e. the bottom of Hell, and its branches rise up to its levels

celaleyn:65-65.t: ﴿طَلْعُهَا﴾ likened to the spathe of the palm ﴿كَأَنَّهُ رُءُوسُ الشَّيَاطِينِ﴾ the snakes of hideous appearance

celaleyn:66-66.t: ﴿فَإِنَّهُمْ﴾ i.e. the disbelievers ﴿لَآكِلُونَ مِنْهَا﴾ despite its hideousness, because of the severity of their hunger ﴿فَمَالِئُونَ مِنْهَا الْبُطُونَ﴾

celaleyn:67-67.t: ﴿ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمْ عَلَيْهَا لَشَوْبًا مِنْ حَمِيمٍ﴾ i.e. hot water which they drink, and it mixes with what is eaten of it and becomes a mixture for it

celaleyn:68-68.t: ﴿ثُمَّ إِنَّ مَرْجِعَهُمْ لَإِلَى الْجَحِيمِ﴾ this indicates that they come out of it to drink the boiling water, and that it is outside it

celaleyn:70-70.t: ﴿فَهُمْ عَلَى آثَارِهِمْ يُهْرَعُونَ﴾ they are urged on to following them, and so they hasten to it

celaleyn:71-71.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ ضَلَّ قَبْلَهُمْ أَكْثَرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ﴾ of the past nations

celaleyn:72-72.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِمْ مُنْذِرِينَ﴾ messengers who warned

celaleyn:73-73.t: ﴿فَانْظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُنْذَرِينَ﴾ the disbelievers, i.e. their end was the punishment

celaleyn:74-74.t: ﴿إِلَّا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ الْمُخْلِصِينَ﴾ i.e. the believers, for they were saved from the punishment because of their sincerity in worship, or because Allah made them pure for it, according to the reading with fatḥa on the lām [الْمُخْلَصِينَ]

celaleyn:75-75.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ نَادَانَا نُوحٌ﴾ by his saying, "My Lord, I am overcome, so help" ﴿فَلَنِعْمَ الْمُجِيبُونَ﴾ to him are We; i.e. he called upon Us against his people, and We destroyed them by drowning

celaleyn:76-76.t: ﴿وَنَجَّيْنَاهُ وَأَهْلَهُ مِنَ الْكَرْبِ الْعَظِيمِ﴾ i.e. the drowning.

celaleyn:77-77.t: ﴿وَجَعَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُ هُمُ الْبَاقِينَ﴾ so all people are of his progeny, peace be upon him. He had three sons: Sām (Shem), who is the father of the Arabs, the Persians and the Byzantines; Ḥām (Ham), who is the father of the Blacks; and Yāfath (Japheth), the father of the Turks, the Khazars, Gog and Magog and those who are there

celaleyn:78-78.t: ﴿وَتَرَكْنَا﴾ We left ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ goodly praise ﴿فِي الْآخِرِينَ﴾ among the prophets and nations until the Day of Resurrection

celaleyn:80-80.t: ﴿إِنَّا كَذَلِكَ﴾ as We recompensed him ﴿نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ﴾

celaleyn:81-81.t: ﴿إِنَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ [Translator's note: al-Jalalayn gives no explanation here]

celaleyn:82-82.t: ﴿ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا الْآخَرِينَ﴾ the disbelievers of his people

celaleyn:83-83.t: ﴿وَإِنَّ مِنْ شِيعَتِهِ﴾ i.e. of those who followed him in the foundation of the religion ﴿لَإِبْرَاهِيمَ﴾ even though the time between them was long, namely two thousand six hundred and forty years; and between them were Hūd and Ṣāliḥ

celaleyn:84-84.t: ﴿إِذْ جَاءَ﴾ i.e. he followed him at the time of his coming ﴿رَبَّهُ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ﴾ from doubt and other things

celaleyn:85-85.t: ﴿إِذْ قَالَ﴾ in this state, which remained constant for him ﴿لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِ﴾ rebuking ﴿مَاذَا﴾ what is it that ﴿تَعْبُدُونَ﴾

celaleyn:86-86.t: ﴿أَئِفْكًا﴾ in its two hamzas there is what has preceded ﴿آلِهَةً دُونَ اللَّهِ تُرِيدُونَ﴾ «إِفْكًا» is a mafʿūl lahu (object of purpose) and «آلِهَةً» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «تُرِيدُونَ»; and ifk is the worst of lies; i.e. do you worship other than Allah?

celaleyn:87-87.t: ﴿فَمَا ظَنُّكُمْ بِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ﴾ if you worship other than Him, that He will leave you unpunished? No! They were astrologers, and they went out to a festival of theirs and left their food by their idols, claiming to seek blessing upon it, so that when they returned they would eat it; and they said to the master Abraham, "Come out with us"

celaleyn:88-88.t: ﴿فَنَظَرَ نَظْرَةً فِي النُّجُومِ﴾ to make them imagine that he relied on them, so that they would rely on him

celaleyn:89-89.t: ﴿فَقَالَ إِنِّي سَقِيمٌ﴾ ill, i.e. I shall become ill

celaleyn:91-91.t: ﴿فَرَاغَ﴾ turned secretly ﴿إِلَى آلِهَتِهِمْ﴾ and they are the idols, with the food beside them ﴿فَقَالَ﴾ mockingly ﴿أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ﴾ and they did not speak, so he said:

celaleyn:92-92.t: ﴿مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنْطِقُونَ﴾ and he was not answered

celaleyn:93-93.t: ﴿فَرَاغَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضَرْبًا بِالْيَمِينِ﴾ with strength, and he broke them; and news reached his people from someone who had seen him

celaleyn:94-94.t: ﴿فَأَقْبَلُوا إِلَيْهِ يَزِفُّونَ﴾ i.e. hastening their walk; and they said to him, "We worship them and you break them?"

celaleyn:95-95.t: ﴿قَالَ﴾ to them, rebuking ﴿أَتَعْبُدُونَ مَا تَنْحِتُونَ﴾ of stone and other things, as idols

celaleyn:96-96.t: ﴿وَاللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ وَمَا تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ of your carving and what you carve; so worship Him alone. And «مَا» is maṣdariyya (verbal-noun forming), and it is said to be a relative (mawṣūla), and it is said to be qualified (mawṣūfa)

celaleyn:97-97.t: ﴿قَالُوا﴾ among themselves ﴿ابْنُوا لَهُ بُنْيَانًا﴾ and fill it with firewood and kindle it with fire, and when it blazes ﴿فَأَلْقُوهُ فِي الْجَحِيمِ﴾ the intense fire

celaleyn:98-98.t: ﴿فَأَرَادُوا بِهِ كَيْدًا﴾ by throwing him into the fire so that it would destroy him ﴿فَجَعَلْنَاهُمُ الْأَسْفَلِينَ﴾ the overpowered; and he came out of the fire unharmed

celaleyn:99-99.t: ﴿وَقَالَ إِنِّي ذَاهِبٌ إِلَى رَبِّي﴾ emigrating to Him from the abode of disbelief ﴿سَيَهْدِينِ﴾ to where my Lord has commanded me to go, which is Syria (al-Shām); and when he reached the Holy Land he said:

celaleyn:101-101.t: ﴿فَبَشَّرْنَاهُ بِغُلَامٍ حَلِيمٍ﴾ i.e. possessed of much forbearance

daas-irab:1-3.t: ﴿وَالصَّافَّاتِ﴾ the wāw is a particle of oath and a preposition; الصافات is a noun in the genitive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are both attached to (mutaʿalliq) something omitted, its implied form being "أقسم" (I swear). ﴿صَفًّا﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿فَالزَّاجِراتِ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and الزاجرات is conjoined to الصافات. ﴿زَجْراً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq. ﴿فَالتَّالِياتِ ذِكْراً﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, التاليات is a noun conjoined to what precedes it, and ذكرا is a mafʿūl muṭlaq. [Translator's note: the source parses ذكرا here as a mafʿūl muṭlaq, though it is commonly parsed as a mafʿūl bihi.]

daas-irab:4-4.t: ﴿إِنَّ إِلهَكُمْ لَواحِدٌ﴾ إنّ and its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and واحد is the khabar (predicate) of إنّ; the clause is the answer of the oath, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:5-5.t: ﴿رَبُّ﴾ a badal (substitute) from واحد. ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَما﴾ conjoined to السموات. ﴿بَيْنَهُما﴾ an adverb of place. ﴿وَرَبُّ﴾ conjoined to the first رب. ﴿الْمَشارِقِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi.

daas-irab:6-6.t: ﴿إِنَّا﴾ إنّ and its noun. ﴿زَيَّنَّا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿السَّماءَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾ a ṣifa (adjective). ﴿بِزِينَةٍ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) زينا. ﴿الْكَواكِبِ﴾ ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition); the nominal clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:7-7.t: ﴿وَحِفْظاً﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and حفظا is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb: "حفظناها حفظا" (We guarded it with a guarding). ﴿مِنْ كُلِّ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) حفظا. ﴿شَيْطانٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مارِدٍ﴾ a ṣifa (adjective).

daas-irab:8-8.t: ﴿لا يَسَّمَّعُونَ﴾ لا is negating, and an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿إِلَى الْمَلَإِ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) يسمعون. ﴿الْأَعْلى﴾ a ṣifa (adjective). ﴿وَيُقْذَفُونَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it, with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْ كُلِّ﴾ both attached to يقذفون. ﴿جانِبٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

daas-irab:10-10.t: ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿مَنْ﴾ the relative noun, in the position of accusative as the excepted (mustathnā). ﴿خَطِفَ﴾ a past verb; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿الْخَطْفَةَ﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿فَأَتْبَعَهُ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its object. ﴿شِهابٌ﴾ a postponed fāʿil (agent). ﴿ثاقِبٌ﴾ a ṣifa (adjective) of شهاب; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa).

daas-irab:11-11.t: ﴿فَاسْتَفْتِهِمْ﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter; the fāʿil (agent) is necessarily latent (mustatir), its implied form being "anta" (you), and the hāʾ is its object. ﴿أَهُمْ﴾ the hamza is an interrogative particle, and هم is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أَشَدُّ﴾ khabar (predicate). ﴿خَلْقاً﴾ tamyīz (specification). The verbal clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), with no grammatical position, and the nominal clause is in the position of accusative as the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of استفتهم. ﴿أَمْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative noun conjoined to the pronoun هم. ﴿خَلَقْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ﴿إِنَّا﴾ إنّ and its noun. ﴿خَلَقْناهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is the khabar of إنا, and the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْ طِينٍ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) خلقناهم. ﴿لازِبٍ﴾ a ṣifa (adjective) of طين.

daas-irab:12-12.t: ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿عَجِبْتَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَيَسْخَرُونَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and an imperfect verb, nominative, and its fāʿil; the clause يسخرون is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "هم يسخرون" (they mock), and the nominal clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:13-13.t: ﴿وَإِذا﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and إذا is adverbial, conditional and non-jussive. ﴿ذُكِّرُوا﴾ a passive past verb and nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿يَذْكُرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:14-14.t: ﴿وَإِذا﴾ conjoined to what precedes. ﴿رَأَوْا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿آيَةً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿يَسْتَسْخِرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and its fāʿil; the clause is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:15-15.t: ﴿وَقالُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; قالوا is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿إِنْ﴾ negating. ﴿هذا﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿سِحْرٌ﴾ khabar (predicate); the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿مُبِينٌ﴾ a ṣifa (adjective) of سحر.

daas-irab:16-16.t: ﴿أَإِذا﴾ the hamza is a particle of disapproving interrogation (inkārī), and إذا is adverbial, conditional and non-jussive. ﴿مِتْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿وَكُنَّا﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb and its noun; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿تُراباً﴾ its khabar (predicate). ﴿وَعِظاماً﴾ conjoined to ترابا. ﴿أَإِنَّا﴾ the hamza is a particle of disapproving interrogation, and إنّ and its noun. ﴿لَمَبْعُوثُونَ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) and a khabar.

daas-irab:17-17.t: ﴿أَوَ﴾ the hamza is an interrogative particle and the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿آباؤُنَا﴾ a noun conjoined to what precedes. ﴿الْأَوَّلُونَ﴾ a naʿt (adjective) of آباؤنا.

daas-irab:18-18.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent), its implied form being "anta" (you); the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿نَعَمْ﴾ a particle of response. ﴿وَأَنْتُمْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial; أنتم is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿داخِرُونَ﴾ khabar (predicate); the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:19-19.t: ﴿فَإِنَّما﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa. ﴿إنما﴾ a restraining (kāffa) and restrained (makfūfa) particle. ﴿هِيَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿زَجْرَةٌ﴾ khabar (predicate). ﴿واحِدَةٌ﴾ a ṣifa (adjective); the clause is the apodosis of an implied condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَإِذا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction and إذا is of surprise (fujāʾiyya). ﴿هُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَنْظُرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative; the wāw is fāʿil (agent); the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ.

daas-irab:20-20.t: ﴿وَقالُوا﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and a past verb and its object [Translator's note: so in the source («ومفعوله»); the wāw is in fact the verb's fāʿil (agent)]; the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿يا وَيْلَنا﴾ يا is a vocative particle, and a munādā (the one addressed) that is muḍāf; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿هذا﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَوْمُ﴾ khabar (predicate). ﴿الدِّينِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:21-21.t: ﴿هذا﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَوْمُ﴾ khabar (predicate). ﴿الْفَصْلِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a ṣifa (adjective) of اليوم. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ كان and its noun. ﴿بِهِ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) تكذبون. ﴿تُكَذِّبُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the khabar of كنتم, and the clause كنتم is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:22-22.t: ﴿احْشُرُوا﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl) of an omitted verb of saying. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿ظَلَمُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَأَزْواجَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a noun conjoined to the relative noun. ﴿وَما﴾ conjoined. ﴿كانُوا﴾ كان and its noun. ﴿يَعْبُدُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of كان.

daas-irab:23-23.t: ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فَاهْدُوهُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, and an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; the clause is the apodosis of an implied condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِلى صِراطِ﴾ both attached to اهدوهم. ﴿الْجَحِيمِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi.

daas-irab:24-24.t: ﴿وَقِفُوهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object. ﴿إِنَّهُمْ﴾ إنّ and its noun. ﴿مَسْؤُلُونَ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of إنّ. The verbal clause is conjoined to what precedes it, with no grammatical position, and the nominal clause gives the reason for the command.

daas-irab:25-25.t: ﴿ما لَكُمْ﴾ ما is an interrogative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and the preposition and its genitive noun are its khabar (predicate); the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl) of an omitted verb of saying. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿تَناصَرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:26-26.t: ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of conjunction and digression (iḍrāb). ﴿هُمُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الْيَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿مُسْتَسْلِمُونَ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ هم.

daas-irab:27-27.t: ﴿وَأَقْبَلَ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and a past verb; the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿بَعْضُهُمْ﴾ fāʿil (agent). ﴿عَلى بَعْضٍ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) أقبل. ﴿يَتَساءَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative; the wāw is fāʿil; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:28-28.t: ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿إِنَّكُمْ﴾ إنّ and its noun; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ كان and its noun. ﴿تَأْتُونَنا﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of كنتم, and the clause كنتم is the khabar of إنّ. ﴿عَنِ الْيَمِينِ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl.

daas-irab:29-29.t: ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿لَمْ تَكُونُوا﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم; the wāw is its noun; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿مُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of تكونوا.

daas-irab:30-30.t: ﴿وَما﴾ ما is negating. ﴿كانَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿لَنا﴾ a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted second khabar. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿سُلْطانٍ﴾ a noun, genitive in form, nominative in position, the noun of كان. ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of conjunction and digression (iḍrāb). ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ كان and its noun. ﴿قَوْماً﴾ its khabar. ﴿طاغِينَ﴾ a ṣifa (adjective) of قوم.

daas-irab:31-31.t: ﴿فَحَقَّ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿عَلَيْنا﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) حق. ﴿قَوْلُ﴾ fāʿil (agent). ﴿رَبِّنا﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِنَّا﴾ إنّ and its noun. ﴿لَذائِقُونَ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and ذائقون is the khabar (predicate) of إنّ; the nominal clause gives the reason for what precedes.

daas-irab:32-32.t: ﴿فَأَغْوَيْناكُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and أغوينا is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿إِنَّا﴾ إنّ and its noun. ﴿كُنَّا﴾ كان and its noun; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of إنّ. ﴿غاوِينَ﴾ the khabar of كنا; the nominal clause gives the reason for what precedes.

daas-irab:33-33.t: ﴿فَإِنَّهُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle. ﴿إنهم﴾ إنّ and its noun. ﴿يَوْمَئِذٍ﴾ يوم is an adverb of time annexed to its like (إذ), and the tanwīn compensates for an omitted clause. ﴿فِي الْعَذابِ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) مشتركون. ﴿مُشْتَرِكُونَ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of إنهم.

daas-irab:34-34.t: ﴿إِنَّا﴾ إنّ and its noun. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾ a ṣifa (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿نَفْعَلُ﴾ an imperfect verb; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of إنّ. ﴿بِالْمُجْرِمِينَ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) نفعل; the nominal clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:35-35.t: ﴿إِنَّهُمْ﴾ إنّ and its noun. ﴿كانُوا﴾ كان and its noun; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of إنّ. ﴿إِذا﴾ adverbial, conditional and non-jussive. ﴿قِيلَ﴾ a passive past verb; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) قيل. ﴿لا إِلهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ﴾ its i'rab has preceded; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl) of an omitted verb of saying. ﴿يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the khabar of كانوا, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted.

daas-irab:36-36.t: ﴿وَيَقُولُونَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, nominative, and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined to يستكبرون. ﴿أَإِنَّا﴾ the hamza is a particle of disapproving interrogation (inkārī), and إنّ and its noun. ﴿لَتارِكُوا﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) and the khabar (predicate) of إنّ; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿آلِهَتِنا﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and نا is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لِشاعِرٍ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) تاركوا. ﴿مَجْنُونٍ﴾ a ṣifa (adjective).

daas-irab:37-37.t: ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿جاءَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "huwa" (he). ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) جاء. ﴿وَصَدَّقَ﴾ a past verb; the clause is conjoined to جاء. ﴿الْمُرْسَلِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

daas-irab:38-38.t: ﴿إِنَّكُمْ﴾ إنّ and its noun. ﴿لَذائِقُوا﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) and the khabar (predicate) of إنّ. ﴿الْعَذابِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الْأَلِيمِ﴾ a ṣifa (adjective) of العذاب; the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:9-9.t: ﴿دُحُوراً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَلَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿عَذابٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿واصِبٌ﴾ a ṣifa (adjective) of عذاب.

daas-irab:39-39.t: ﴿وَما تُجْزَوْنَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; ما is negating; تجزون is a passive imperfect verb and nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿ما﴾ a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ كان and its noun. ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of كنتم, and the clause of the defective verb is the ṣila (relative clause).

daas-irab:40-40.t: ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿عِبادَ﴾ excepted (mustathnā). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الْمُخْلَصِينَ﴾ a ṣifa (adjective) of عباد الله.

daas-irab:41-41.t: ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿رِزْقٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿مَعْلُومٌ﴾ a ṣifa (adjective) of رزق; the nominal clause is the khabar of أولئك.

daas-irab:42-42.t: ﴿فَواكِهُ﴾ a badal (substitute) of the whole for the whole. ﴿وَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); هم is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مُكْرَمُونَ﴾ khabar (predicate); the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:43-43.t: ﴿فِي جَنَّاتِ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) مكرمون. ﴿النَّعِيمِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

daas-irab:44-44.t: ﴿عَلى سُرُرٍ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) متقابلين. ﴿مُتَقابِلِينَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:45-45.t: ﴿يُطافُ﴾ a passive imperfect verb; the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) يطاف. ﴿بِكَأْسٍ﴾ also both attached to يطاف. ﴿مِنْ مَعِينٍ﴾ a ṣifa (adjective) of كأس.

daas-irab:46-46.t: ﴿بَيْضاءَ﴾ a second ṣifa (adjective) of كأس. ﴿لَذَّةٍ﴾ a third ṣifa of كأس. ﴿لِلشَّارِبِينَ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) لذة.

daas-irab:47-47.t: ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿فِيها﴾ a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿غَوْلٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿وَلا﴾ conjoined to the first لا. ﴿هُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿عَنْها﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) ينزفون. ﴿يُنْزَفُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, nominative, and nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ هم, and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it; the clause لا فيها غول is a ṣifa (adjective) of كأس.

daas-irab:48-48.t: ﴿وَعِنْدَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿قاصِراتُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿الطَّرْفِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿عِينٌ﴾ a ṣifa (adjective) of قاصرات.

daas-irab:49-49.t: ﴿كَأَنَّهُنَّ﴾ كأنّ and its noun. ﴿بَيْضٌ﴾ its khabar (predicate); the clause is a ṣifa (adjective) of قاصرات. ﴿مَكْنُونٌ﴾ a ṣifa.

daas-irab:50-50.t: ﴿فَأَقْبَلَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb. ﴿بَعْضُهُمْ﴾ fāʿil (agent). ﴿عَلى بَعْضٍ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) أقبل. ﴿يَتَساءَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and its fāʿil; the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).

daas-irab:51-51.t: ﴿قالَ قائِلٌ مِنْهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the preposition and its genitive noun are a ṣifa (adjective) of قائل. ﴿إِنِّي كانَ لِي قَرِينٌ﴾ إنّ and its noun; كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the clause is the khabar (predicate) of إنّ; the nominal clause with its khabar is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl); لي is a preposition and its genitive noun, the fronted khabar of كان, and قرين is its postponed noun.

daas-irab:52-53.t: ﴿يَقُولُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative; the clause is a ṣifa (adjective) of قرين. ﴿أَإِنَّكَ﴾ the hamza is a particle of disapproving interrogation (inkārī), and إنّ and its noun. ﴿لَمِنَ الْمُصَدِّقِينَ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and the preposition and its genitive noun are the khabar (predicate) of إنّ; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿أَإِذا مِتْنا﴾ the hamza is an interrogative particle, and an adverb for the future that carries the sense of condition, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿وَكُنَّا﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb and its noun. ﴿تُراباً﴾ its khabar. ﴿وَعِظاماً﴾ a noun conjoined to ترابا. ﴿أَإِنَّا﴾ the hamza is an interrogative particle, and إنّ and its noun. ﴿لَمَدِينُونَ﴾ the shifted lām, and مدينون is a khabar, nominative with the wāw.

daas-irab:54-59.t: ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir). ﴿هَلْ﴾ an interrogative particle. ﴿أَنْتُمْ مُطَّلِعُونَ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate), nominative with the wāw; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فَاطَّلَعَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil latent. ﴿فَرَآهُ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil latent and the hāʾ its object; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it, with no grammatical position. ﴿فِي سَواءِ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) رآه. ﴿الْجَحِيمِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil latent. ﴿تَاللَّهِ﴾ the tāʾ is a particle of oath and a preposition, and the Name of Majesty is genitive by it; both are attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "أقسم" (I swear). ﴿إِنْ﴾ lightened from the heavy (inna). ﴿كِدْتَ﴾ a past verb; its clause is the answer of the oath, with no grammatical position. ﴿لَتُرْدِينِ﴾ the distinguishing lām (al-lām al-fāriqa), and an imperfect verb, nominative, its fāʿil latent, its implied form being "anta" (you); the dropped yāʾ is its object. ﴿وَلَوْلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and لولا is a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿نِعْمَةُ﴾ mubtadaʾ, and the khabar is necessarily omitted. ﴿رَبِّي﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَكُنْتُ﴾ the lām occurs in the answer of لولا, and كان and its noun. ﴿مِنَ الْمُحْضَرِينَ﴾ both attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿أَفَما﴾ the hamza is an interrogative particle, the fāʾ is a conjunction, and ما is negating. ﴿نَحْنُ﴾ the noun of ما. ﴿بِمَيِّتِينَ﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; ميتين is genitive in form, accusative in position, the khabar of ما. The clause is conjoined to something omitted and implied. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿مَوْتَتَنَا﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿الْأُولى﴾ a ṣifa (adjective). ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and ما is negating. ﴿نَحْنُ﴾ its noun. ﴿بِمُعَذَّبِينَ﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant preposition, and معذبين is genitive in form, accusative in position, the khabar of ما; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:60-70.t: ﴿إِنَّ هذا﴾ إنّ and its noun. ﴿لَهُوَ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and the pronoun is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الْفَوْزُ﴾ khabar (predicate). ﴿الْعَظِيمُ﴾ a ṣifa (adjective); the clause is the khabar of إنّ. ﴿لِمِثْلِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) يعمل. ﴿هذا﴾ هـا is for calling attention (tanbīh), and the demonstrative is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فَلْيَعْمَلِ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, the lām is the lām of command, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm). ﴿الْعامِلُونَ﴾ fāʿil (agent), nominative with the wāw. ﴿أَذلِكَ﴾ the hamza is a particle of disapproving interrogation (inkārī), and the demonstrative is mubtadaʾ. ﴿خَيْرٌ﴾ khabar. ﴿نُزُلًا﴾ tamyīz (specification). ﴿أَمْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿شَجَرَةُ﴾ a noun conjoined to ذلك. ﴿الزَّقُّومِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl) of an omitted verb of saying. ﴿إِنَّا﴾ إنّ and its noun. ﴿جَعَلْناها﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its first object. ﴿فِتْنَةً﴾ the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿لِلظَّالِمِينَ﴾ both attached to an omitted ṣifa of فتنة; the clause جعلناها is the khabar of إنّ. ﴿إِنَّها شَجَرَةٌ﴾ إنّ, its noun and its khabar. ﴿تَخْرُجُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative. ﴿فِي أَصْلِ﴾ both attached to تخرج; the clause of إنّ with its noun and khabar is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the clause تخرج is a ṣifa of شجرة. ﴿الْجَحِيمِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿طَلْعُها﴾ mubtadaʾ, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿كَأَنَّهُ﴾ كأنّ and its noun. ﴿رُؤُسُ﴾ its khabar. ﴿الشَّياطِينِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the khabar of طلعها. ﴿فَإِنَّهُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and إنّ and its noun. ﴿لَآكِلُونَ﴾ the shifted lām and a khabar; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it, with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْها﴾ both attached to آكلون. ﴿فَمالِؤُنَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and مالئون is a noun conjoined to آكلون. ﴿مِنْها﴾ both attached to مالئون. ﴿الْبُطُونَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi of the active participle مالئون. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ both attached to its fronted khabar. ﴿عَلَيْها﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿لَشَوْباً﴾ the shifted lām and its postponed noun. ﴿مِنْ حَمِيمٍ﴾ both attached to an omitted ṣifa of شوبا; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it, with no grammatical position. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿إِنَّ مَرْجِعَهُمْ﴾ إنّ and its noun. ﴿لَإِلَى الْجَحِيمِ﴾ the shifted lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar of إنّ. ﴿إِنَّهُمْ﴾ إنّ and its noun. ﴿أَلْفَوْا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of إنّ. ﴿آباءَهُمْ﴾ the first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ضالِّينَ﴾ the second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَهُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and the pronoun is mubtadaʾ. ﴿عَلى آثارِهِمْ﴾ both attached to يهرعون. ﴿يُهْرَعُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb; the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ هم.

daas-irab:71-80.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; the lām is the answer to an omitted oath, and قد is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq). ﴿ضَلَّ﴾ a past verb. ﴿قَبْلَهُمْ﴾ an adverb. ﴿أَكْثَرُ﴾ the fāʿil (agent) of ضل. ﴿الْأَوَّلِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with the yāʾ. ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; the lām occurs in the answer of the oath, and قد is a particle of affirmation. ﴿أَرْسَلْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿فِيهِمْ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) أرسلنا. ﴿مُنْذِرِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative with the yāʾ. ﴿فَانْظُرْ﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and an imperative verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir). ﴿كَيْفَ﴾ an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as the fronted khabar (predicate) of كان. ﴿عاقِبَةُ﴾ its postponed noun. ﴿الْمُنْذَرِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause انظر is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿عِبادَ﴾ excepted (mustathnā), accusative. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْمُخْلَصِينَ﴾ a ṣifa (adjective) of عباد. ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, the lām is the answer to an omitted oath, and قد is a particle of affirmation. ﴿نادانا﴾ a past verb and its object. ﴿نُوحٌ﴾ a postponed fāʿil; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَلَنِعْمَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, the lām is the answer to an omitted oath, and an inflexible (jāmid) past verb. ﴿الْمُجِيبُونَ﴾ fāʿil, nominative with the wāw; the clause is conjoined, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَنَجَّيْناهُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is conjoined to the oath, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَأَهْلَهُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a noun conjoined to the hāʾ in نجيناه. ﴿مِنَ الْكَرْبِ﴾ both attached to نجيناه. ﴿الْعَظِيمِ﴾ a ṣifa of الكرب. ﴿وَجَعَلْنا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿ذُرِّيَّتَهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿هُمُ﴾ a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl), with no grammatical position. ﴿الْباقِينَ﴾ the second mafʿūl bihi of جعلنا. ﴿وَتَرَكْنا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ both attached to تركنا. ﴿فِي الْآخِرِينَ﴾ both attached to an omitted ṣifa of the implied object "ثناء" (praise); the clause تركنا is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿سَلامٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿عَلى نُوحٍ﴾ both attached to an omitted khabar; the clause is explicative (tafsīriyya). ﴿فِي الْعالَمِينَ﴾ both attached to an omitted khabar. ﴿إِنَّا﴾ إنّ and its noun. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾ a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿نَجْزِي﴾ an imperfect verb; the clause is the khabar of إنّ. ﴿الْمُحْسِنِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the nominal clause gives the reason (taʿlīl).

daas-irab:81-90.t: ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ إنّ and its noun. ﴿مِنْ عِبادِنَا﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are its khabar (predicate). ﴿الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ a ṣifa (adjective). ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿أَغْرَقْنَا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿الْآخَرِينَ﴾ its object, accusative with the yāʾ; the clause is conjoined to نجيناه, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَإِنَّ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and إنّ is a particle resembling the verb. ﴿مِنْ شِيعَتِهِ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are the fronted khabar of إنّ. ﴿لَإِبْراهِيمَ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and إبراهيم is its postponed noun; the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿جاءَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir). ﴿رَبَّهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿بِقَلْبٍ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) جاء. ﴿سَلِيمٍ﴾ a ṣifa of قلب. ﴿إِذْ﴾ a badal (substitute) from the first adverb. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil latent. ﴿لِأَبِيهِ﴾ both attached to قال. ﴿وَقَوْمِهِ﴾ conjoined to أبيه. ﴿ماذا﴾ an interrogative noun, the fronted object of تعبدون. ﴿تَعْبُدُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and its fāʿil; the interrogative clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿أَإِفْكاً﴾ the hamza is a particle of interrogation of disapproval and rebuke, and إفكا is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿آلِهَةً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿دُونَ﴾ an adverb. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿تُرِيدُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and its fāʿil; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿فَما﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and ما is interrogative, for disapproval and rebuke, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿ظَنُّكُمْ﴾ its khabar. ﴿بِرَبِّ﴾ both attached to ظنكم. ﴿الْعالَمِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the yāʾ; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَنَظَرَ﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and نظر is a past verb, its fāʿil latent. ﴿نَظْرَةً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. [Translator's note: so in the source; نظرة is usually parsed as a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of number.] ﴿فِي النُّجُومِ﴾ both attached to نظر; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَقالَ﴾ a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil latent. ﴿إِنِّي﴾ إنّ and its noun. ﴿سَقِيمٌ﴾ its khabar; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl, and the clause قال is conjoined to what precedes it, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَتَوَلَّوْا﴾ a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿عَنْهُ﴾ both attached to تولوا. ﴿مُدْبِرِينَ﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:91-95.t: ﴿فَراغَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir). ﴿إِلى آلِهَتِهِمْ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) راغ. ﴿فَقالَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil latent. ﴿أَلا﴾ the hamza is for interrogation and لا is negating. ﴿تَأْكُلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl), and the clause راغ is conjoined to what precedes it, with no grammatical position. ﴿ما لَكُمْ﴾ ما is interrogative, mubtadaʾ (subject); لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, the khabar (predicate). ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿تَنْطِقُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), and the nominal clause is the maqūl of an omitted verb of saying, its implied form being "فلم ينطقوا فقال ما لكم لا تنطقون" (they did not speak, so he said: what is the matter with you that you do not speak?). ﴿فَراغَ﴾ its i'rab has preceded. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ both attached to راغ. ﴿ضَرْباً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it, with no grammatical position. ﴿بِالْيَمِينِ﴾ both attached to ضربا. ﴿فَأَقْبَلُوا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ both attached to أقبلوا; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it, with no grammatical position. ﴿يَزِفُّونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil latent. ﴿أَتَعْبُدُونَ﴾ the hamza is a particle of interrogation of disapproval and rebuke, and an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿ما﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿تَنْحِتُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause تنحتون is the ṣila (relative clause), the clause تعبدون is the maqūl al-qawl, and the clause قال is resumptive (mustaʾnafa).

daas-irab:96-100.t: ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative. ﴿خَلَقَكُمْ﴾ a past verb and its object; the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and ما is a relative pronoun. ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), and the nominal clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿ابْنُوا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿لَهُ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) ابنوا. ﴿بُنْياناً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فَأَلْقُوهُ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is conjoined to ابنوا. ﴿فِي الْجَحِيمِ﴾ both attached to ألقوه. ﴿وَقالَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb. ﴿إِنِّي ذاهِبٌ﴾ إنّ, its noun and its khabar; the nominal clause is the maqūl al-qawl, and the clause قال is conjoined to what precedes it, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِلى رَبِّي﴾ both attached to ذاهب. ﴿سَيَهْدِينِ﴾ the sīn is a particle of futurity, and an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the dropped yāʾ is its object, i.e. سيهديني. ﴿رَبِّ﴾ a munādā (the one addressed) annexed to the dropped yāʾ of the first person. ﴿هَبْ﴾ a verb of supplication, its fāʿil latent (mustatir). ﴿لِي﴾ both attached to هب; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ﴾ both attached to an omitted ṣifa (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl bihi, i.e. "هب لي ولدا من الصالحين" (grant me a child from among the righteous).

daas-irab:101-102.t: ﴿فَبَشَّرْناهُ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object. ﴿بِغُلامٍ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) بشرناه. ﴿حَلِيمٍ﴾ a ṣifa (adjective); the clause is conjoined to قال, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and لما is adverbial, conditional and non-jussive. ﴿بَلَغَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir). ﴿مَعَهُ﴾ an adverb attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿السَّعْيَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil latent. ﴿يا بُنَيَّ﴾ يا is a vocative particle, and بني is a munādā (the one addressed) that is muḍāf; the clause قال has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the clause بلغ is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿إِنِّي﴾ إنّ and its noun; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿أَرى﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of إني. ﴿فِي الْمَنامِ﴾ both attached to أرى. ﴿إِنِّي﴾ أنّ and its noun. [Translator's note: the source parses this second إني as أنّ («أن واسمها»).] ﴿أَذْبَحُكَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, its fāʿil latent; the clause is the khabar of أني, and أنّ with what follows it stands in place of the two objects of أرى. ﴿فَانْظُرْ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, and an imperative verb, its fāʿil latent; the clause is the apodosis of an implied condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿ماذا﴾ interrogative, in the position of accusative as the object of ترى. ﴿تَرى﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil latent; the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). ﴿يا أَبَتِ﴾ يا is a vocative particle, and a munādā annexed to the yāʾ of the first person, for which the tāʾ has been substituted; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿افْعَلْ﴾ an imperative verb, its fāʿil latent. ﴿ما﴾ a relative pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿تُؤْمَرُ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, its nāʾib (deputy agent) latent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, with no grammatical position. ﴿سَتَجِدُنِي﴾ the sīn is a particle of futurity, and an imperfect verb, nominative, and its object; the fāʿil is latent. ﴿إِنْ﴾ a jussive conditional particle. ﴿شاءَ﴾ a past verb. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, fāʿil. ﴿مِنَ الصَّابِرِينَ﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl.

daas-irab:103-107.t: ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and لما is adverbial, conditional and non-jussive. ﴿أَسْلَما﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿وَتَلَّهُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿لِلْجَبِينِ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) تله; the clause أسلما is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿وَنادَيْناهُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its object. ﴿أَنْ﴾ explicative (mufassira). ﴿يا إِبْراهِيمُ﴾ يا is a vocative particle; إبراهيم is a munādā (the one addressed), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma. ﴿قَدْ﴾ a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq). ﴿صَدَّقْتَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿الرُّؤْيا﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِنَّا﴾ إنّ and its noun. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾ a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), placed before the verb. ﴿نَجْزِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, its fāʿil latent. ﴿الْمُحْسِنِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the yāʾ; the clause is the khabar (predicate), and the clause إنا is causal (taʿlīliyya). ﴿إِنَّ هذا﴾ إنّ and its noun. ﴿لَهُوَ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) and a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الْبَلاءُ﴾ khabar. ﴿الْمُبِينُ﴾ a ṣifa (adjective) of البلاء; the nominal clause is the khabar of إنّ. ﴿وَفَدَيْناهُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is conjoined to ناديناه. ﴿بِذِبْحٍ﴾ both attached to فديناه. ﴿عَظِيمٍ﴾ a ṣifa.

daas-irab:108-115.t:
﴿وَتَرَكْنا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣifa (adjective) of the omitted qualified noun. ﴿فِي الْآخِرِينَ﴾ both attached to تركنا. ﴿سَلامٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿عَلى إِبْراهِيمَ﴾ both attached to an omitted khabar (predicate); the clause is the speech reported (maqūl) of the omitted verb of saying. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾ the demonstrative is a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ إنّ and its noun. ﴿مِنْ عِبادِنَا﴾ both attached to an omitted khabar. ﴿الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ a ṣifa of عبادنا; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَبَشَّرْناهُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its object. ﴿بِإِسْحاقَ﴾ both attached to بشرناه. ﴿نَبِيًّا﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are a ṣifa of نبيا. ﴿وَبارَكْنا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it, with no grammatical position. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ both attached to باركنا. ﴿وَعَلى إِسْحاقَ﴾ conjoined to the preceding preposition and genitive noun. ﴿وَمِنْ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle and من is a preposition. ﴿مِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِهِما﴾ both attached to a fronted khabar. ﴿مُحْسِنٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَظالِمٌ﴾
conjoined to محسن. ﴿لِنَفْسِهِ﴾ both attached to ظالم. ﴿مُبِينٌ﴾ a ṣifa of ظالم; the nominal clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, the lām occurs in the answer to the omitted oath, and قد is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq). ﴿مَنَنَّا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿عَلى مُوسى﴾ both attached to مننا. ﴿وَهارُونَ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it; the clause is the answer of the oath, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَنَجَّيْناهُما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is conjoined to مننا, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَقَوْمَهُما﴾ mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment), accusative. ﴿مِنَ الْكَرْبِ﴾ both attached to نجيناهما. ﴿الْعَظِيمِ﴾ a ṣifa.

daas-irab:116-120.t: ﴿وَنَصَرْناهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَكانُوا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and كان and its noun. ﴿هُمُ﴾ tawkīd (emphasis) of the wāw of the plural. ﴿الْغالِبِينَ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of كانوا. ﴿وَآتَيْناهُمَا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its first object. ﴿الْكِتابَ﴾ its second object. ﴿الْمُسْتَبِينَ﴾ a ṣifa (adjective) of الكتاب. ﴿وَهَدَيْناهُمَا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its first object. ﴿الصِّراطَ﴾ its second object. ﴿الْمُسْتَقِيمَ﴾ a ṣifa of الصراط. ﴿وَتَرَكْنا عَلَيْهِما فِي الْآخِرِينَ﴾ its i'rab has preceded at verse 108. ﴿سَلامٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿عَلى مُوسى﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar. ﴿وَهارُونَ﴾ conjoined to what precedes.

daas-irab:121-124.t: ﴿إِنَّا﴾ إنّ and its noun. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾ a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿نَجْزِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative. ﴿الْمُحْسِنِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of إنّ. ﴿إِنَّهُما﴾ إنّ and its noun. ﴿مِنْ عِبادِنَا﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar. ﴿الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ a ṣifa (adjective). ﴿وَإِنَّ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and إنّ is a particle resembling the verb. ﴿إِلْياسَ﴾ the noun of إنّ. ﴿لَمِنَ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) and a preposition. ﴿الْمُرْسَلِينَ﴾ a noun in the genitive; both are attached to the omitted khabar; the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir). ﴿لِقَوْمِهِ﴾ both attached to قال; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿أَلا﴾ a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ). ﴿تَتَّقُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).

daas-irab:125-132.t: ﴿أَتَدْعُونَ﴾ the hamza is a particle of disapproving interrogation (inkārī), and an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿بَعْلًا﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَتَذَرُونَ﴾ a conjunction, and an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿أَحْسَنَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْخالِقِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause تدعون is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl), and the clause تذرون is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Name of Majesty, a badal (substitute) from أحسن, accusative like it. ﴿رَبَّكُمْ﴾ a badal from the Name of Majesty. ﴿وَرَبَّ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿آبائِكُمُ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْأَوَّلِينَ﴾ a ṣifa (adjective). ﴿فَكَذَّبُوهُ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is conjoined to the clause قال, in the position of genitive like it. ﴿فَإِنَّهُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, and إنّ and its noun. ﴿لَمُحْضَرُونَ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) and the khabar (predicate) of إنّ, nominative with the wāw; the nominal clause has no grammatical position. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿عِبادَ﴾ excepted (mustathnā) by إلا, accusative. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْمُخْلَصِينَ﴾ a ṣifa of عباد. ﴿وَتَرَكْنا عَلَيْهِ فِي الْآخِرِينَ﴾ its i'rab has preceded. ﴿سَلامٌ عَلى إِلْ ياسِينَ﴾ its i'rab has preceded. ﴿إِنَّا كَذلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ﴾ its i'rab has preceded. ﴿إِنَّهُ مِنْ عِبادِنَا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ its i'rab has preceded.

daas-irab:133-137.t:
﴿وَإِنَّ لُوطاً﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and إنّ and its noun. ﴿لَمِنَ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) and a preposition. ﴿الْمُرْسَلِينَ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of إنّ; the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿نَجَّيْناهُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿وَأَهْلَهُ﴾ mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment). ﴿أَجْمَعِينَ﴾ tawkīd (emphasis). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿عَجُوزاً﴾ excepted (mustathnā) by إلا, accusative. ﴿فِي الْغابِرِينَ﴾ both attached to a ṣifa (adjective). ﴿ثُمَّ﴾
a conjunction. ﴿دَمَّرْنَا﴾
a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿الْآخَرِينَ﴾
mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined to نجيناه. ﴿وَإِنَّكُمْ﴾
the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and إنّ and its noun. ﴿لَتَمُرُّونَ﴾
the shifted lām, and an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and its fāʿil; the clause إنكم is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾
both attached to تمرون; the verbal clause is the khabar of إنّ. ﴿مُصْبِحِينَ﴾
ḥāl.

daas-irab:138-142.t:
﴿وَبِاللَّيْلِ﴾
the wāw is a conjunction, and the preposition and its genitive noun are conjoined to مصبحين. ﴿أَفَلا﴾
the hamza is a particle of rebuking interrogation, the fāʾ is a conjunction, and لا is negating. ﴿تَعْقِلُونَ﴾
an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined to an omitted one, its implied form being "تشاهدون ذلك" (you witness that). ﴿وَإِنَّ يُونُسَ﴾
the wāw is a resumptive particle, and إنّ and its noun. ﴿لَمِنَ﴾
the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and من is a preposition. ﴿الْمُرْسَلِينَ﴾
a noun in the genitive; the preposition and its genitive noun are the khabar (predicate) of إنّ. ﴿إِذْ﴾
an adverb of time. ﴿أَبَقَ﴾
a past verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir). ﴿إِلَى الْفُلْكِ﴾
both attached to (mutaʿalliq) أبق. ﴿الْمَشْحُونِ﴾
a ṣifa (adjective); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿فَساهَمَ﴾
the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil latent. ﴿فَكانَ﴾
a conjunction, and a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, its noun latent, its implied form being "huwa" (he). ﴿مِنَ الْمُدْحَضِينَ﴾
both attached to the implied khabar of كان. ﴿فَالْتَقَمَهُ﴾ a conjunction, and a past verb and its object. ﴿الْحُوتُ﴾ a postponed fāʿil. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and هو is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مُلِيمٌ﴾ khabar; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:143-146.t: ﴿فَلَوْلا﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and لولا is a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿أَنَّهُ﴾ أنّ and its noun. ﴿كانَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿مِنَ الْمُسَبِّحِينَ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are the khabar (predicate) of كان; أنّ with what follows it is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar is necessarily omitted, and the clause كان is the khabar of أنّ. ﴿لَلَبِثَ﴾ the lām occurs in the answer of لولا, and a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir). ﴿فِي بَطْنِهِ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) لبث. ﴿إِلى يَوْمِ﴾ also both attached to لبث. ﴿يُبْعَثُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿فَنَبَذْناهُ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction joining to something omitted and implied, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its object. ﴿بِالْعَراءِ﴾ both attached to نبذناه. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and a mubtadaʾ. ﴿سَقِيمٌ﴾ khabar; the nominal clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَأَنْبَتْنا﴾ a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to نبذناه. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ both attached to أنبتنا. ﴿شَجَرَةً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مِنْ يَقْطِينٍ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are a ṣifa (adjective) of شجرة.
